prospective_status: Additional fixed estimator family designed and registered before opening any A1 scientific return. Original A1 gates and outcomes remain separate.
contexts: Exactly the A1 frozen policy snapshots; reconstructed training is charged as qualification overhead. New disjoint reference-bank episode seeds. No policy or critic tuning on either score or validation outcomes.
primary_target: Undiscounted native episodic team return difference to the same complete fresh HAPPO reference. No clipping, self-normalization, critic-loss substitution or learned ratio model.
variance_comparison: Amortize the one shared native reference bank across all three prespecified candidate scores. Report candidate-marginal cost-adjusted variance and the joint score covariance; do not treat three scores as independent.
validation: The already prospectively frozen A1 disjoint validation bank is reused for estimator checking only, after both score roots are complete; no additional validation is called free training data.
decision: Score qualification only. All fixed methods and every context are reported; method selection is not based on the most favorable outcome. A failure retains evidence and triggers a precision/cost diagnosis, not threshold changes. No GPU/controller claim without a separate nonvacuous confidence and causal launch/receipt interface.
